# Mohammad Aatif Shaikh

```
Tampa, FL | +1-813-568-5612 | mohammadaatif@usf.edu | linkedin.com/in/shaikhaatif | github.com/aatif101
```

## Summary

AI-native builder with security instincts. CS senior (graduating Dec 2026) who has shipped real
agentic systems: a LangGraph/ColPali/Qdrant document intelligence pipeline for Pfizer, LLM eval
harnesses at an AI startup (CacheAi), a web vulnerability scanner with AI triage (NazScan), and
MCP tooling most engineers haven't touched yet. I use Claude Code and Cursor daily as force
multipliers — I build at a level that doesn't match my experience on paper.
Targeting applied AI, LLMOps, and AI security roles at early-stage companies.

## Skills

- **AI / Agentic Systems:** LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, agentic RAG, critic/reflection loops, HITL queues, query decomposition, multi-agent orchestration, MCP tooling
- **LLM / VLM:** Claude API, GPT-4, ColQwen2 / ColPali, VLM-based extraction, prompt engineering, guardrails, Pydantic schemas
- **RAG & Retrieval:** Hybrid RAG (BM25 + vector), Qdrant, ColPali visual retrieval, Cohere Rerank, LlamaIndex, two-stage retrieval
- **Observability & Evals:** Langfuse tracing, eval harness design, F1/latency/cost benchmarking, LLM eval pipelines
- **Document AI:** IBM Docling (Granite-Docling-258M), OCR (Tesseract, PaddleOCR, EasyOCR), PyMuPDF, table extraction
- **Security:** Web vulnerability scanning (SQLi, XSS, CSRF, SSRF, OWASP), CVSS scoring, CTF background, bug bounty (in progress)
- **Cloud & Infra:** AWS (EC2, RDS, Lambda, S3, CloudWatch), Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Ansible, GitHub Actions, Jenkins
- **Languages:** Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Go, Bash, C++, C#, SQL
- **Backend & UI:** REST APIs, PostgreSQL, async Python, Streamlit, Supabase, React Native / Expo

## Projects

### Reliu - HabitHealth iOS App
_Founder build - zero to TestFlight in 3 days_

- Built and shipped a full-stack iOS habit-tracking app with AI coaching for a founder, taking the product from blank repo to TestFlight-ready build in 3 days.
- Built the React/TypeScript + Supabase product and packaged it through Capacitor/Xcode, keeping one codebase moving fast enough for founder review and release testing.
- Turned an idea into a testable product so the founder could move into software testing and real user feedback instead of staying in prototype mode.

### NazScan — Web Application Security Scanner | github.com/aatif101/nazscan
_Python · Async · OWASP · AI triage · Bug bounty integration_ — **In active development (Phase 3/5)**

- Built a full async web vulnerability scanner covering SQLi (error/boolean/time-based), XSS (reflected/stored/DOM), CSRF, SSRF,
  open redirects, directory traversal, command injection, insecure headers, SSL/TLS misconfigs, and subdomain enumeration.
- Custom payload library with context-aware injection; crawler/spider module with auth flow handling and scope boundaries.
- Rate limiting and exponential backoff for responsible scanning; CVSS-style severity scoring with remediation guidance.
- **Shipping next:** AI-assisted triage layer (LLM reduces false positives, explains vulns in plain English, maps exploitation paths);
  authenticated scan flows; plugin architecture; HackerOne/Bugcrowd export integration.
- Built to use on real bug bounty targets — this is applied learning, not a tutorial project.



### AI-Powered Cloud Autoscaler | github.com/aatif101
_Python · AWS · Kubernetes · ML_

- Built an ML-driven autoscaler that predicts load and right-sizes cloud resources — produced measurable cloud cost reduction.
- Applied ML inference to infrastructure decisions; deployed on Kubernetes with AWS integrations.

### LawyerUp — Legal AI Assistant | Hackathon 2024
_LLM · RAG · React_

- Built a Legora-style AI legal research assistant at a 2024 hackathon — RAG over legal documents, natural language Q&A.

### MCP Tooling (Private / In Progress)
- Building custom MCP servers and tools — Model Context Protocol is bleeding edge; most engineers haven't shipped with it yet.
- Experimenting with agent-to-agent communication and AI workflow automation via MCP.

## Experience

### Pfizer (via Externship Program) | AI/ML Extern — Pharmaceutical Document Intelligence
_Mar 2026 – Apr 2026_

- Architected an end-to-end AI document intelligence system for Pfizer supplier documentation (SDFs) — went beyond course curriculum by replacing the standard PyMuPDF/Tesseract stack with a modern 2026 agentic pipeline.
- Document parsing with IBM Docling (Granite-Docling-258M): 97.9% table extraction accuracy on complex pharmaceutical PDFs.
- Agentic field extraction using VLMs into validated Pydantic schemas with a critic/reflection loop (extractor → critic → reconciliation); each field includes confidence score + bounding-box citation. Low-confidence results route to a human-in-the-loop review queue.
- Visual + hybrid RAG chatbot: ColQwen2 (colpali-engine) indexed in Qdrant with mean-pool + rerank two-stage retrieval, BM25 hybrid search over Docling text, and a Cohere reranker.
- LangGraph-orchestrated agentic RAG pipeline with query decomposition, retrieval sufficiency evaluation, reflection, and regeneration loop.
- Compliance flagging dashboard (Streamlit) flagging documents older than 3-4 years as risk, with color-coded status per document.
- Langfuse observability integrated throughout; built evaluation harness benchmarking own stack vs. course baseline on F1, table accuracy, latency, and cost per 1000 pages.

### CacheAi | AI/ML Intern
_Jul 2024 – Aug 2024_

- Built LLM evaluation harnesses and RAG pipelines integrating retrieval backends with LLM inference.
- Added latency and cost observability for LLM calls; wired into CI/CD with Docker and GitHub Actions.
- Contributed to internal Python APIs and supported pipeline testing ahead of beta launch.

### USF IT | AV Tech & Workflow Automation
_May 2025 – Present_

- Identified a coordination gap in the AV team's day-to-day operations (20+ technicians, no structured routing system) and built a
  lightweight automation layer for task routing, status updates, and technician handoffs.
- System was adopted into the broader USF IT toolkit — solved a real problem no one else had prioritized.
- Maintained ~99% uptime across 100+ lab PCs; AV infrastructure serving 200+ classes/week.

### Mozilla | Open Source Contributor (via Bugzilla)

- Contributed to Firefox DevTools: issue triage, CI/CD-related fixes, and DevOps documentation improvements.
- Accepted into Meta MLH Site Reliability Engineering Fellowship (unable to attend due to medical circumstances).

### Infrastructure Docs Collective | Open Source Contributor

- Merged 20+ PRs: Terraform modules, GitHub Actions workflows, Ansible playbooks, EKS deployments, AWS IAM/VPC walkthroughs.
- Improved time-to-first-deploy for new contributors through onboarding guides and infrastructure readmes.

## Education

### University of South Florida | B.S. Computer Science
_Aug 2022 – Dec 2026 | GPA: 3.6_

- USF Green & Gold Scholarship Recipient
- Relevant coursework: Intro to AI, Network Analysis & ML, Software Engineering, Algorithms, Data Structures

## Leadership

### USF Student Government | Senator
_May 2024 – May 2025_

- Helped oversee $2M+ in student activity funds (ASRC); ensured compliance with Title-8 Finance Code.
- Drove updates to 10+ statutes; served on 3+ committees concurrently.
